name: Aegis Shield Coating
desc: Apply Aegis-grade ablative coating to any torso part. Increases armor by 2.
notes: Entry-level NTPD blueprint. +2 armor on any torso is significant early game.

name: Neural Regulator Assembly
desc: Craft an AT-NR Neural Regulator from scratch. Cheaper than buying, better than finding.
notes: Craft the tier 3 stress dampener. Cheaper than buying at 100 cred vendor price.

name: Hardened Armor Plating
desc: Reinforce any arm or leg part with Aegis composite plating. +1 armor, +10 max HP.
notes: Defensive mod for limbs. +10 HP is almost another integrity bar on light parts.

name: Custom Aegis Sentinel Frame
desc: Build a personalized Sentinel frame with enhanced DEF and COR. The frame the police wish they had.
notes: Endgame NTPD reward. Custom Sentinel with +2 DEF, +1 COR over base. The definitive Medium defensive frame.

name: Kuroda Reinforced Plating
desc: Apply military-grade reinforcement to any part. +2 armor, +1 integrity bar.
notes: +1 integrity bar is MASSIVE. Turns a 2-bar arm into a 3-bar arm. The premier defensive blueprint.

name: Siege Weapon System
desc: Modify any shoulder-mounted weapon to deal +20% damage. Kuroda siege doctrine: more firepower, always.
notes: +20% damage on shoulder weapons. On a Type 12 Judgment (9 base damage), that's +1.8 damage per hit.

name: Heavy Weapon Stabilizer
desc: Reduce heat generation on any weapon by 3. Kuroda cooling infrastructure adapted for field use.
notes: -3 heat gen on ANY weapon. Turns hot weapons into manageable ones.

name: Custom Type 90 Fortress Frame
desc: Build a personalized Type 90 with enhanced firepower. Steele's own modifications, shared as a sign of respect.
notes: Endgame Kuroda reward. Custom Type 90 with +1 ATK, +1 DEF. The heaviest, deadliest frame in the game.

name: Custom Overclock Module
desc: Build an improved RC Overclock Module. +2 ATK instead of +1, same drawbacks. More risk, more reward.
notes: Red Creek philosophy: more power, more problems. The cheap aggression option.

name: Scrapyard Frankenstein
desc: Combine 3 damaged parts into 1 functional part of random type. The Underground's recycling philosophy.
notes: The 'recycle' blueprint. Turn trash into treasure. Random output keeps it interesting. The scrapyard philosophy made mechanical.

name: Sora Efficiency Overhaul
desc: Modify any Light frame to reduce heat generation by 10% and supply consumption by 10%.
notes: Light frame specialization. -10% heat + +10% supply = dramatically extended mission endurance.

name: KZ Labor-to-Combat Conversion
desc: Convert any KZ labor part to combat spec. +1 ATK contribution, +5 HP, but +1 weight.
notes: Turns cheap KZ parts into combat-viable gear. The Underground converts everything.

name: Hayabusa Mk.I Full Restoration
desc: Restore Dad's original Hayabusa to factory-new condition. All stats improved to design spec.
notes: Narrative reward. Restore the Hayabusa to what Dad intended. +1 to three base stats + 10 heatCap makes it competitive with Medium frames. The sentimental choice vs buying a new frame.

name: Taeyang Thermal Coating
desc: Apply Taeyang thermal insulation to any part. Reduces heatMod by 3.
notes: Also drops from Crimson Nail. -3 heatMod per part. Apply to 4 parts = -12 total heat profile.

name: Taeyang Plasma Core
desc: Craft a TY-X Plasma Capacitor backpack. Converts 10% of heat generated into bonus energy damage.
notes: Heat-to-damage conversion at equipment level. Stacks with Neural Override maneuver.

name: Thermal Weapon Forge
desc: Modify any fight-category weapon to deal bonus thermal damage. +15% damage, +3 heat per hit.
notes: Turn ANY melee weapon into a thermal weapon. +15% damage at +3 heat/hit cost.

name: Custom Supernova Mk.II
desc: Forge a personalized Supernova heat blade. The hottest weapon in New Tokyo, tuned to your fighting style.
notes: The endgame melee weapon. 14 damage (vs 12 base Supernova) + 5 accuracy. Costs a fortune in materials.

name: Phantom Stealth Coating
desc: Apply sensor-absorbing material to any part. -5% enemy accuracy against this frame.
notes: Per-part evasion. Apply to all 4 parts = -20% enemy accuracy. Stacks with ECM Suite.

name: Quantum Processor Upgrade
desc: Install a Phantom quantum processor in any arm. +3 accuracy, +5% ERROR token chance on attacks.
notes: +3 accuracy AND ERROR token generation. Phantom's electronic warfare on your arms.

name: Daewon Advanced Sensor Integration
desc: Upgrade a frame's sensor system. +8 accuracy, reveals enemy part HP. Requires Daewon parts installed.
notes: Requires at least 1 Daewon part installed on the frame. The Tactician's ultimate sensor package.

name: Custom Phantom Wraith Frame
desc: Build a personalized Wraith with enhanced stealth systems. The ghost that haunts New Tokyo.
notes: Endgame Phantom reward. Custom Wraith with +1 ATK, +2 ENR, +5% evasion. The ultimate Light glass cannon.

name: Hayabusa Mk.II
desc: Dad's unfinished masterwork. Complete the frame he was designing for Phantom Works. A Light frame that rivals Heavy frames.
notes: THE endgame goal. Dad's dream — a Light frame with stats approaching Heavy. ATK 5 (vs Heavy's 5-8), DEF 4 (vs Heavy's 5-7), ENR 8 (best in game), COR 6 (matches Type 90). heatCap 95 is unprecedented for Light. Requires the most materials and the highest skills of any blueprint. Three skill gates (crafting 9, mecha_tech 7, combat 6) ensure the player has mastered all aspects of the game. The narrative payoff for finishing what Dad started.
